base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_019" FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1."XCL_021" = T2."XCL_007"
INNER JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1."XCL_023" = T3."XCL_005"
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T4 ON T1."XCL_018" = T4."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN attribute AS T5 ON T4."XCL_010" = T5."XCL_003"
WHERE T2."XCL_008" = 'Male' AND T3."XCL_006" = 'Blue' AND T5."XCL_004" = 'Intelligence'
AND T4."XCL_011" < (SELECT AVG(T4."XCL_011") FROM hero_attribute AS T4 INNER JOIN attribute AS T5 ON T4."XCL_010" = T5."XCL_003" WHERE T5."XCL_004" = 'Intelligence')

FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
JOIN colour c ON s.XCL_022 = c.XCL_005
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
JOIN attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
WHERE g.XCL_008 = 'Male'
  AND c.XCL_006 = 'Blue'
  AND a.XCL_004 = 'Intelligence'
  AND ha.XCL_011 < (
    SELECT AVG(ha2.XCL_011)
    FROM hero_attribute ha2
    JOIN attribute a2 ON ha2.XCL_010 = a2.XCL_003
    WHERE a2.XCL_004 = 'Intelligence'
  )
